dedupe_keys.name: relationship between road network characteristics and traffic safety

description: Hatim Sharif and Samer Dessouky publish the supporting dataset for Tran-SET project 17ITSTSA01 on road-network characteristics and safety in San Antonio. Zenodo provides a ZIP archive free under CC BY 4.0 and identifies an equivalent LSU repository page. The study describes intersection crashes, traffic exposure and driver, road and environmental factors, with frequency, rate and hotspot analyses. These observations can constrain intersection-risk assumptions and compare road-safety scenarios in transport simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this project dataset. Coverage is the study’s San Antonio intersections, but observation years and the internal archive schema are not stated in the landing metadata. Associations between driver categories and crash counts do not by themselves establish causal risk. Denominator consistency, location matching and missing incidents remain uncertain. No archive was downloaded, crash records inspected or statistical findings independently reproduced.
